0022600227.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, 4-2 at home, 7-3 in their last ten, currently on a one-game losing streak) host the Toronto Raptors (5-6, 2-3 on the road... no wait) in their 13th game of the 2026-27 season. The 76ers are 2nd in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic, 1 game back, while the Raptors are 7th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic, 4.5 games back, and have lost their last two games and six of their last ten.
